text: 中钢协发布2026年7月钢铁产品进出口月报，7月，我国出口钢材1012.1万吨，环比下降1.9%，同比增长2.9%；出口均价715.7美元/吨，环比上涨0.7%，同比上涨1.9%。1—7月，我国累计出口钢材6499.5万吨，同比下降4.4%；出口均价703.4美元/吨，同比上涨0.6%。7月，我国进口钢材44.5万吨，环比增长0.9%，同比下降1.7%；进口均价1952.4美元/吨，环比上涨1.4%，同比上涨8.2%。1—7月，我国累计进口钢材314.0万吨，同比下降10.1%；进口均价1818.9美元/吨，同比上涨5.8%。
text_en: The China Iron and Steel Association released the July 2026 steel product import and export monthly report. In July, China exported 10.121 million tons of steel, down 1.9% month-on-month and up 2.9% year-on-year; the average export price was $715.7 per ton, up 0.7% month-on-month and 1.9% year-on-year. From January to July, cumulative steel exports were 64.995 million tons, down 4.4% year-on-year; the average export price was $703.4 per ton, up 0.6% year-on-year. In July, steel imports were 445,000 tons, up 0.9% month-on-month and down 1.7% year-on-year; the average import price was $1,952.4 per ton, up 1.4% month-on-month and 8.2% year-on-year. From January to July, cumulative steel imports were 3.14 million tons, down 10.1% year-on-year; the average import price was $1,818.9 per ton, up 5.8% year-on-year.
